turns.user: I fractured my leg, the tibia, when I fell down the stairs. It's a simple fracture and the X-ray confirmed it. How much can I claim?
turns.visible:
Ivan’s Arbor Civil Service Group Personal Accident wording lists a Simple Fracture benefit limit of S$5,000 per insured person per accident, and lists 50% of that limit for a leg (tibia or fibula) fracture (page 1).
Based on what you told me, the calculator gives a conditional illustration of S$2,500 if the insurer’s medical assessment determines the fracture meets the policy’s definition of a simple fracture; this is not a confirmed claim amount, and only for an injury the insurer accepts as caused by an accident (the policy says “Accident means a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means”).

turns.user: I was also in hospital for 48 hours: admitted 5 October 2026 at 10am, discharged 7 October 2026 at 10am. Does the Daily Hospital Income pay anything?
turns.visible:
Ivan’s Daily Hospital Income is listed as S$150 for each day of inpatient confinement directly resulting from an Accident, payable from the 11th day of continuous confinement and up to 180 days per Accident (page 2).
The calculator finds no benefit for the 48-hour stay you reported, because it does not reach the 11th day of continuous confinement.
Arbor Civil Service Group Personal Accident - Policy Wording daily hospital income does not apply to these facts: the stay you reported (48 hours, from 5 October 2026 to 7 October 2026: at most 3 days even counting the days of admission and discharge) does not reach the 11th day of confinement that the benefit is payable from (“payable from the 11th day of continuous confinement”), if this provision applies to the stay.

Arbor Assurance - Civil Service Group Personal Accident - Policy Wording (Group Policy No. GA-4410)
Section 4 - Fracture Benefits
4.1 Simple Fracture
The Simple Fracture benefit limit is S$5,000 for each Insured Person per Accident. We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture benefit limit shown below for a simple fracture confirmed by X-ray.
Bone fractured                                % of Simple Fracture benefit limit
Skull                                         100%

support.text: Arbor Assurance - Civil Service Group Personal Accident - Policy Wording (Group Policy No.

passage.text:
Thigh (femur)                                 60%
Leg (tibia or fibula)                         50%
Arm (humerus, radius or ulna)                 40%
Finger or toe                                 10%
4.2 Other Fracture
Other Fracture: for a compound fracture, or a fracture of a bone not listed in 4.1, we will pay 5% of the Sum Insured shown for the Insured Person under Group Personal Accident in the Certificate of Group Insurance.

Section 4 - Fracture Benefits
4.1 Simple Fracture
The Simple Fracture benefit limit is S$5,000 for each Insured Person per Accident. We will pay the percentage of the Simple Fracture benefit limit shown below for a simple fracture confirmed by X-ray.
Bone fractured                                % of Simple Fracture benefit limit
Skull                                         100%

support.text: Arbor Assurance - Civil Service Group Personal Accident - Policy Wording (Group Policy No.

passage.text:
Thigh (femur)                                 60%
Leg (tibia or fibula)                         50%
Arm (humerus, radius or ulna)                 40%
Finger or toe                                 10%
4.2 Other Fracture
Other Fracture: for a compound fracture, or a fracture of a bone not listed in 4.1, we will pay 5% of the Sum Insured shown for the Insured Person under Group Personal Accident in the Certificate of Group Insurance.

support.text: Other Fracture: for a compound fracture, or a fracture of a bone not listed in 4.1, we will pay 5% of the Sum Insured shown for the Insured Person under Group Personal Accident in the Certificate of Group Insurance.

Accident means a sudden, unforeseen and involuntary event caused by external, violent and visible means.
